n: Let's Talk Science Code a Dance in Scratch
t: A hands on activity where learners code a dancing sprite in Scratch.
steps: Find the Code a Dance in Scratch page on the Let's Talk Science site.
Read the safety precautions that the page points to.
Open the appendix with the sample dance code.
Set up a device with Scratch for each learner or group.
Build a short dance yourself first.
Note that the activity is aimed at volunteers. A facilitator may be assumed.
